name: writer
description: Plan and write a novel with GitHub: local-first writing app, story bible and diagrams.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/editor/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:template: node scripts/build-validator.ts templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/validate.mjs && node scripts/build-validator.ts --snapshots templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs && node scripts/build-validator.ts --compile templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/compile.mjs && node scripts/vendor-tools.ts templates/journal templates/campaign templates/nonfiction && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs templates/novel && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs examples/sample-novel && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs templates/journal && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs examples/sample-journal && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs templates/campaign && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs examples/sample-campaign && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs templates/nonfiction && node templates/novel/.github/gh-writer/snapshots.mjs examples/sample-nonfiction && node scripts/compile-schemas.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @writer/editor && npm run test:e2e -w @writer/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build:server && npm run fetch:runtime && npm run dev -w @writer/desktop
scripts.desktop:arch: npm run build:server && npm run fetch:runtime && packages/desktop/arch/build.sh
